_comment: Manifest of hospitals in the pipeline. Status flow: discovered -> mapped -> parsed -> qa_pending -> seeded (or flagged). See docs/adding-a-hospital.md.

hospitals.name: Dell Seton Medical Center at UT Austin
Baylor Scott & White Medical Center Austin
hospitals.notes: Mislabels ~400k CPT-code rows as HCPCS. Handled by the default 5-digit-numeric promotion rule, not a per-hospital override -- column_map_file exists mainly as a record of the issue.

hospitals.name: St. David's Medical Center Austin
hospitals.notes: HCA-format CMS v3.0.0 JSON, nested structure -- parsed by parse-json.js, not parse-csv.js.

hospitals.name: The Methodist Hospital
hospitals.notes: CMS v3.0.0 JSON, same nested standard_charge_information/code_information/standard_charges/payers_information shape as st-davids-austin -- parsed by parse-json.js. Verified live 2026-10-11: HTTP 200, ~68.7MB, last-modified 2026-03-25. Flagship Texas Medical Center campus (CMS name 'The Methodist Hospital'); Houston Methodist also publishes separate files for Baytown, Clear Lake, Cypress, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, West Houston, Willowbrook, and Continuing Care -- not added here, each would need its own manifest entry. EIN taken from filename prefix, not an explicit field in this file's header (unlike the CSV hospitals). First QA pass failed (zero CPT codes -- found parse-json.js was missing the HCPCS->CPT promotion rule parse-csv.js already had; 138,437 codes were mislabeled). Fixed in parse-json.js, re-verified: 99.4% CPT overlap with other hospitals. See data/qa-reports/houston-methodist.md.

hospitals.name: The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
hospitals.notes: CMS v3.0.0 WIDE-format CSV (1,421 columns, 47 payers), not tall like the Ascension files -- required a new scripts/parse-csv-wide.js, not a column-map override. Verified live 2026-10-11: HTTP 200, text/csv, ~120.6MB, last-modified 2026-10-07. QA passed (data/qa-reports/md-anderson-houston.md): 1,028,611 rows seeded, 96% CPT-code overlap with other hospitals, clean payer names, no negative rates. MD Anderson also separately publishes a ProfessionalCharge.csv (physician/professional charges, not facility standard charges) at the same path -- not added here; this pipeline tracks hospital facility files only, consistent with the other 4 hospitals.
